 strings happen to match. This records the evidence boundary for native IDs
 whose independently available source supplies membership but no canonical name.
+
+The `metacyc-reaction-xml` source kind supports the bounded case of a genuinely
+unnamed native small-molecule reaction. It accepts only an exact HTTPS request
+`https://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr/getxml?id=META:<frame>` and one original
+full META `Reaction` with matching metadata query, PGDB version, species
+`MetaCyc`, and identity attributes. The root software-version field must also
+match this supported serialization; it does not replace the explicit PGDB
+version check. The exact HTTPS base/service or the observed mirror's literal
+HTTP-with-port-443 base/service are supported. Alternate requests, ports,
+duplicate metadata/entities, class instances, HTML, DTDs and entities fail.
+Original declared XML encoding and bytes are retained unchanged.
+
+This adapter requires both native `Chemical-Reactions` and
+`Small-Molecule-Reactions` parents, a native reaction direction, and nonempty
+left/right sides containing exact empty META Compound references. Explicit
+coefficient/compartment slots, generic class participants and other native
+serialization forms are currently unsupported and fail rather than being
+silently normalized. A direct `common-name` slot of any shape also fails: named
+reaction support is not an implicit fallback. Nested evidence/curator names,
+equations and curated labels never supply a canonical reaction name.
+
+The emitted label is only the exact native frame token, with no synonyms,
+`label_kind: source_context` and `entity_type: reaction`. Its source metadata
+carries `kind: metacyc-reaction-xml`. These optional fields have closed validation:
+the type and source kind must occur together, with a coherent MetaCyc identifier,
+frame-token label and source-context scope. The loader also requires the exact
+META frame requested by its source URL at the HTTPS endpoint
+above, with no extra query fields or fragment and with a dotted numeric native
+version. Each term must match its source's requested frame; one source cannot
+establish a different typed identity. These offline checks establish internal
+snapshot consistency. The builder checks the original XML bytes, including
+their agreement with the request and version. This typed authority can satisfy
+only a `reactions` node explicitly categorized `molecular_activity`. The checker
+enforces this restriction **before** contextual-label bypass, so the same ID
+cannot pass as a record title, pathway interface, protein, complex or chemical.
+An explicit contextual policy is still required; native identity is not a
+canonical name authority. Existing authority objects without these fields keep
+their prior behavior and bytes. Builder and checker support must be adopted
+together; older checkers correctly reject the unfamiliar fields.
+
+Conflicting same-frame reaction versions, parents, directions, sides or native
+flags fail before corpus selection. A same-frame assertion from a different
+source kind also fails rather than dropping the reaction type or inventing a
+canonical name. This identity support does not establish pathway membership,
+selected physiological flux, catalytic machinery, or chemical equivalence;
+those claims still require separate mechanistic evidence.

+class _MetaCycReactionTreeBuilder(ElementTree.TreeBuilder):
+    def doctype(self, name: str, pubid: str | None, system: str | None) -> None:
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction XML must not contain a DOCTYPE")
+
+
+def _metacyc_reaction_record(
+    path: Path, *, url: str, version: str,
+) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, list[str]], tuple]:
+    """Establish typed native identity for an unnamed small-molecule reaction.
+
+    This deliberately does not name a reaction from nested curator/evidence
+    objects, its equation, or a curated record. Named reactions and more complex
+    participant serialization remain unsupported by this bounded adapter.
+    """
+    request = re.fullmatch(
+        rf"https://{re.escape(ECOCYC_HOST)}/getxml\?id=(META:([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*))",
+        url,
+    )
+    if request is None:
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction requires an exact native HTTPS META request")
+    requested, frame = request.groups()
+    root = ElementTree.fromstring(
+        path.read_bytes(), parser=ElementTree.XMLParser(target=_MetaCycReactionTreeBuilder()),
+    )
+
+    def one(parent: ElementTree.Element, tag: str) -> ElementTree.Element:
+        nodes = parent.findall(tag)
+        if len(nodes) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"MetaCyc reaction requires exactly one direct {tag}")
+        return nodes[0]
+
+    def text(parent: ElementTree.Element, tag: str, *, native: bool = False) -> str:
+        node = one(parent, tag)
+        if (len(node) or node.attrib != ({"datatype": "string"} if native else {})
+                or not (node.text or "").strip()):
+            raise ValueError(f"MetaCyc reaction requires one nonempty native {tag}")
+        return node.text.strip()
+
+    if root.tag != "ptools-xml" or len(root) != 2:
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction requires native metadata and one direct Reaction")
+    metadata, reaction = one(root, "metadata"), one(root, "Reaction")
+    if (
+        set(root.attrib) != {"ptools-version", "{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base"}
+        or root.get("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base") not in {
+            url, f"http://{ECOCYC_HOST}:443/getxml?{requested}",
+        }
+        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)+", version)
+        or root.get("ptools-version") != version
+        or (root.text or "").strip() or any((child.tail or "").strip() for child in root)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction XML base or native version disagrees with request")
+    if metadata.attrib or sorted(n.tag for n in metadata) != sorted(
+        ["url", "service_name", "query", "num_results", "PGDB"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction has malformed native metadata")
+    if (
+        text(metadata, "url") not in {
+            f"https://{ECOCYC_HOST}/", f"http://{ECOCYC_HOST}:443/",
+        }
+        or text(metadata, "service_name") != "getxml"
+        or text(metadata, "query") != requested or text(metadata, "num_results") != "1"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction service/query identity mismatch")
+    pgdb = one(metadata, "PGDB")
+    if (
+        pgdb.attrib != {"orgid": "META", "version": version}
+        or [child.tag for child in pgdb] != ["species"]
+        or text(pgdb, "species", native=True) != "MetaCyc"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction PGDB/version/species mismatch")
+    if reaction.attrib != {
+        "ID": requested, "orgid": "META", "frameid": frame, "detail": "full",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction has a mismatched or unresolved top-level identity")
+    # Any direct slot prevents the identity-only path, including an empty,
+    # duplicate, malformed or nested-object name copied into a direct slot.
+    if reaction.findall("common-name"):
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction identity-only adapter requires an absent common-name")
+    parents = []
+    for parent in reaction.findall("parent"):
+        child = one(parent, "Reaction")
+        parent_frame = child.get("frameid", "")
+        if (
+            len(parent) != 1 or parent.attrib or (parent.text or "").strip()
+            or len(child) or (child.text or "").strip()
+            or parent_frame not in {"Chemical-Reactions", "Small-Molecule-Reactions"}
+            or child.attrib != {
+                "resource": "getxml?META:" + parent_frame, "orgid": "META",
+                "frameid": parent_frame, "class": "true",
+            }
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction has an unsupported native parent class")
+        parents.append(parent_frame)
+    if sorted(parents) != ["Chemical-Reactions", "Small-Molecule-Reactions"]:
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction requires chemical and small-molecule parent classes")
+    direction = text(reaction, "reaction-direction")
+    if direction not in {
+        "REVERSIBLE", "LEFT-TO-RIGHT", "RIGHT-TO-LEFT",
+        "PHYSIOL-LEFT-TO-RIGHT", "PHYSIOL-RIGHT-TO-LEFT",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction has an unsupported native direction")
+    sides = []
+    for side in ("left", "right"):
+        slots = reaction.findall(side)
+        if not slots:
+            raise ValueError(f"MetaCyc reaction requires nonempty native {side} slots")
+        participants = []
+        for slot in slots:
+            compound = one(slot, "Compound")
+            compound_frame = compound.get("frameid", "")
+            if (
+                len(slot) != 1 or slot.attrib or (slot.text or "").strip()
+                or len(compound) or (compound.text or "").strip()
+                or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", compound_frame)
+                or compound.attrib != {
+                    "resource": "getxml?META:" + compound_frame,
+                    "orgid": "META", "frameid": compound_frame,
+                }
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction requires exact native Compound side references")
+            participants.append(compound_frame)
+        if len(participants) != len(set(participants)):
+            raise ValueError("MetaCyc reaction repeats a native side participant")
+        sides.append(tuple(sorted(participants)))
+    flags = []
+    for tag in ("spontaneous", "physiologically-relevant"):
+        if reaction.findall(tag):
+            node = one(reaction, tag)
+            if (node.attrib != {"datatype": "boolean"} or len(node)
+                    or node.text not in {"true", "false"}):
+                raise ValueError(f"MetaCyc reaction has a malformed native {tag}")
+            flags.append((tag, node.text))
+    if reaction.findall("orphan"):
+        flags.append(("orphan", text(reaction, "orphan")))
+    assertion = (version, tuple(sorted(parents)), direction, *sides, tuple(flags))
+    return ("MetaCyc:" + frame, frame, []), assertion

@@ -0,0 +1,513 @@
+"""Independent unnamed-reaction fixtures; original source replay is external."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+from pathwaymech.identifiers import identifier_errors
+from scripts.build_source_identifier_snapshot import build_snapshot, main, source_terms
+
+HOST = "bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr"
+KIND = "metacyc-reaction-xml"
+FRAME = "RXN-999991"
+URL = f"https://{HOST}/getxml?id=META:{FRAME}"
+
+
+def native(frame=FRAME):
+    return ET.fromstring(f'''<ptools-xml ptools-version="27.0"
+      xml:base="http://{HOST}:443/getxml?META:{frame}">
+      <metadata><url>http://{HOST}:443/</url><service_name>getxml</service_name>
+        <query>META:{frame}</query><num_results>1</num_results>
+        <PGDB orgid="META" version="27.0"><species datatype="string">MetaCyc</species></PGDB>
+      </metadata>
+      <Reaction ID="META:{frame}" orgid="META" frameid="{frame}" detail="full">
+        <parent><Reaction resource="getxml?META:Chemical-Reactions" orgid="META"
+          frameid="Chemical-Reactions" class="true"/></parent>
+        <parent><Reaction resource="getxml?META:Small-Molecule-Reactions" orgid="META"
+          frameid="Small-Molecule-Reactions" class="true"/></parent>
+        <left><Compound resource="getxml?META:CPD-LEFT" orgid="META" frameid="CPD-LEFT"/></left>
+        <right><Compound resource="getxml?META:CPD-RIGHT" orgid="META" frameid="CPD-RIGHT"/></right>
+        <reaction-direction>REVERSIBLE</reaction-direction><orphan>YES-PUTATIVE</orphan>
+        <spontaneous datatype="boolean">true</spontaneous>
+        <physiologically-relevant datatype="boolean">true</physiologically-relevant>
+        <credits><Person><common-name datatype="string">A curator</common-name></Person></credits>
+      </Reaction></ptools-xml>''')
+
+
+def parse(tmp_path, root=None, *, url=URL, version="27.0", raw=None):
+    path = tmp_path / "native.xml"
+    body = raw if raw is not None else ET.tostring(native() if root is None else root)
+    path.write_bytes(body)
+    result = list(source_terms(KIND, path, url=url, version=version))
+    assert path.read_bytes() == body
+    return result
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("frame", [FRAME, "OTHER-RXN", "Reaction_17.2"])
+def test_unnamed_identity_has_no_accession_exception_or_nested_name(tmp_path, frame):
+    assert parse(tmp_path, native(frame), url=URL.replace(FRAME, frame)) == [
+        ("MetaCyc:" + frame, frame, []),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_native_declared_encoding_and_exact_https_serialization(tmp_path):
+    root = native()
+    root.find("Reaction/credits/Person/common-name").text = "Curateur André"
+    root.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base", URL)
+    root.find("metadata/url").text = f"https://{HOST}/"
+    assert parse(tmp_path, raw=ET.tostring(root, encoding="iso-8859-1")) == [
+        ("MetaCyc:" + FRAME, FRAME, []),
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "", URL.replace("https:", "http:"), URL.replace(HOST, "example.org"),
+    URL.replace(HOST, HOST + ".example.org"), URL.replace(HOST, "user@" + HOST),
+    URL.replace(HOST, HOST + ":443"), URL.replace("META:", "ECOLI:"),
+    URL.replace(FRAME, "RXN-OTHER"), URL.replace("id=", ""), URL + "&detail=full",
+    URL + "&id=META:" + FRAME, URL + "&id=", URL + "#fragment", URL + " ", URL + "\n",
+    URL.replace("getxml", "META/NEW-IMAGE"), URL.replace("META:", "META%3A"),
+    URL.replace(FRAME, "%52XN-999991"), URL.replace(FRAME, "bad:frame"),
+    URL.replace(FRAME, "bad/frame"), URL.replace(FRAME, ""),
+])
+def test_exact_issuing_request_required(tmp_path, url):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="MetaCyc reaction"):
+        parse(tmp_path, url=url)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("problem", [
+    "root-tag", "root-extra", "base-host", "base-frame", "base-port", "base-query", "software",
+    "metadata-missing", "metadata-duplicate", "metadata-extra", "service", "query", "count",
+    "pgdb-missing", "pgdb-duplicate", "pgdb-org", "pgdb-version", "pgdb-extra", "species",
+    "reaction-missing", "reaction-duplicate", "extra-object", "nested-only", "wrong-object",
+    "id", "frame", "organism", "detail", "class", "resource", "extra-attribute",
+    "parent-missing", "parent-duplicate", "parent-type", "parent-reference", "parent-class",
+    "left-missing", "right-empty", "left-extra", "left-wrong-object", "compound-id",
+    "compound-org", "compound-resource", "compound-class", "compound-nested", "side-duplicate",
+    "direction-missing", "direction-duplicate", "direction-invalid", "direction-nested",
+    "name-valid", "name-empty", "name-duplicate", "name-nested-copy", "flag-duplicate",
+    "flag-invalid", "flag-nested", "html",
+])
+def test_ambiguous_native_identity_and_side_serialization_fail(tmp_path, problem):
+    root = native()
+    meta, reaction = root.find("metadata"), root.find("Reaction")
+    if problem == "root-tag":
+        root.tag = "wrong"
+    elif problem == "root-extra":
+        root.set("unknown", "yes")
+    elif problem.startswith("base-"):
+        old = root.get("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base")
+        changes = {"base-host": (HOST, "example.org"), "base-frame": (FRAME, "OTHER"),
+                   "base-port": (":443", ":8080"), "base-query": ("?META:", "?id=META:")}
+        root.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base", old.replace(*changes[problem]))
+    elif problem == "software":
+        root.set("ptools-version", "99.0")
+    elif problem in {"metadata-missing", "metadata-duplicate", "metadata-extra"}:
+        if problem == "metadata-missing":
+            root.remove(meta)
+        elif problem == "metadata-duplicate":
+            root.append(copy.deepcopy(meta))
+        else:
+            ET.SubElement(meta, "extra").text = "value"
+    elif problem in {"service", "query", "count"}:
+        tag = {"service": "service_name", "query": "query", "count": "num_results"}[problem]
+        meta.find(tag).text = "invalid"
+    elif problem.startswith("pgdb-") or problem == "species":
+        pgdb = meta.find("PGDB")
+        if problem == "pgdb-missing":
+            meta.remove(pgdb)
+        elif problem == "pgdb-duplicate":
+            meta.append(copy.deepcopy(pgdb))
+        elif problem == "pgdb-org":
+            pgdb.set("orgid", "ECOLI")
+        elif problem == "pgdb-version":
+            pgdb.set("version", "99.0")
+        elif problem == "pgdb-extra":
+            ET.SubElement(pgdb, "strain").text = "MG1655"
+        else:
+            pgdb.find("species").text = "Escherichia coli"
+    elif problem == "reaction-missing":
+        root.remove(reaction)
+    elif problem == "reaction-duplicate":
+        root.append(copy.deepcopy(reaction))
+    elif problem == "extra-object":
+        ET.SubElement(root, "Protein")
+    elif problem == "nested-only":
+        root.remove(reaction)
+        ET.SubElement(root, "wrapper").append(reaction)
+    elif problem == "wrong-object":
+        reaction.tag = "Protein"
+    elif problem in {"id", "frame", "organism", "detail", "class", "resource", "extra-attribute"}:
+        key = {"id": "ID", "frame": "frameid", "organism": "orgid",
+               "detail": "detail", "class": "class", "resource": "resource",
+               "extra-attribute": "other"}[problem]
+        reaction.set(key, "true" if key == "class" else "wrong")
+    elif problem.startswith("parent-"):
+        parent = reaction.find("parent")
+        child = parent.find("Reaction")
+        if problem == "parent-missing":
+            reaction.remove(parent)
+        elif problem == "parent-duplicate":
+            reaction.append(copy.deepcopy(parent))
+        elif problem == "parent-type":
+            child.tag = "Protein"
+        elif problem == "parent-reference":
+            child.set("resource", "getxml?ECOLI:Chemical-Reactions")
+        else:
+            child.set("class", "false")
+    elif problem.startswith(("left-", "right-", "compound-", "side-")):
+        slot = reaction.find("right" if problem == "right-empty" else "left")
+        compound = slot.find("Compound")
+        if problem == "left-missing":
+            reaction.remove(slot)
+        elif problem == "right-empty":
+            slot.remove(compound)
+        elif problem == "left-extra":
+            ET.SubElement(slot, "coefficient").text = "2"
+        elif problem == "left-wrong-object":
+            compound.tag = "Protein"
+        elif problem == "compound-nested":
+            ET.SubElement(compound, "common-name").text = "Nested name"
+        elif problem == "side-duplicate":
+            reaction.append(copy.deepcopy(slot))
+        else:
+            key = {"compound-id": "frameid", "compound-org": "orgid",
+                   "compound-resource": "resource", "compound-class": "class"}[problem]
+            compound.set(key, "true" if key == "class" else "wrong")
+    elif problem.startswith("direction-"):
+        direction = reaction.find("reaction-direction")
+        if problem == "direction-missing":
+            reaction.remove(direction)
+        elif problem == "direction-duplicate":
+            reaction.append(copy.deepcopy(direction))
+        elif problem == "direction-nested":
+            ET.SubElement(direction, "nested").text = "REVERSIBLE"
+        else:
+            direction.text = "FORWARD"
+    elif problem.startswith("name-"):
+        node = ET.SubElement(reaction, "common-name", {"datatype": "string"})
+        node.text = "A curator" if problem == "name-nested-copy" else "A chemical reaction"
+        if problem == "name-empty":
+            node.text = ""
+        elif problem == "name-duplicate":
+            reaction.append(copy.deepcopy(node))
+    elif problem.startswith("flag-"):
+        flag = reaction.find("spontaneous")
+        if problem == "flag-duplicate":
+            reaction.append(copy.deepcopy(flag))
+        elif problem == "flag-invalid":
+            flag.text = "yes"
+        else:
+            ET.SubElement(flag, "nested").text = "true"
+    else:
+        root = ET.fromstring("<html>Login required</html>")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="MetaCyc reaction"):
+        parse(tmp_path, root)

+def gate(tmp_path, snapshot, record, *, contextual=True):
+    policy = {"version": 1, "namespaces": {"MetaCyc": {
+        "snapshot": "data/identifier_authorities/sources.json", "policy": "canonical"}},
+        "contextual_labels": [{"namespace": "MetaCyc", "sections": [
+            "record", "taxa", "participants", "reactions"], "record_prefixes": ["MetaCyc"],
+            "reason": "Deliberately broad fixture to verify pre-bypass type checks"}]
+        if contextual else []}
+    (tmp_path / "conf").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (tmp_path / "conf/identifier_policy.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(policy))
+    authority = tmp_path / "data/identifier_authorities/sources.json"
+    authority.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    authority.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot))
+    (tmp_path / "data/pathways/fixture.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(record))
+    return identifier_errors(tmp_path)
